code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for c in range(w))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    rm, cm = (r0 + r1) / 2, (c0 + c1) / 2
    color_for_main = None
    color_for_anti = None
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or color == 5:
                continue
            same_sides = (r < rm) == (c < cm)
            if same_sides:
                color_for_main = color
            else:
                color_for_anti = color
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            out[r][c] = color_for_main if ((r <= (r0 + r1) / 2) == (c <= (c0 + c1) / 2)) else color_for_anti
    return out
'''
